prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Miami after a car accident. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Miami for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — I just need two quick details to give the best, tailored recommendations:

1) How badly were you injured (minor injuries, serious injuries/hospitalized, catastrophic/permanent)?  
2) Do you need Spanish-speaking counsel or any other language/accessibility need?

If you want names right away, I can give a short, general list of well-known Miami-area personal injury firms and why people call them, but the most useful choices depend on injury severity and whether you want a big firm vs. a small local trial shop. Tell me the two items above and I’ll reply with 5–7 specific firms to call plus exactly what to ask each one and how to choose the best. 

If you need immediate next steps while you decide on a lawyer:
- Get medical care and preserve records.  
- Take photos of the scene, damage, injuries; save contact info for witnesses.  
- Don’t give a recorded statement to the other driver’s insurer without an attorney.  
- Call 3–5 firms for free consultations (most personal injury attorneys work on contingency). 

Which option do you prefer — quick names now, or first your injury/language details so I can customize the list?
